title: Cottrell, Chris Kelly, Kaiser, McCurtis and the Morgans
summary: Barnes discusses Louis Cottrell with Kelly, Kelly's temper, and other clarinetists including Kaiser, Charlie McCurtis, Joe Watkins and Andrew Morgan.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

He was known as a pretty good musician back then. Yeah, musician, yeah. He told me he played with Chris Kelly, son.
Yeah, yeah.
Now, how did he sound with Chris Kelly? Because you know, he plays a lot of sweet clarinet, doesn't he? Well... He does a lot of readings, doesn't he? He's a musician.

I'll tell you that. You see, Kelly was a hard son. And he took the good man to play the night. George played with him. Before I got angry with him, walked up the music stand. What happened? He got George.

He was really good, Charlie.
What kind? Well, he's a man who'll make all over.
